children: French industrial technology firm Schneider Electric SE
is nearing an agreement to acquire Shelly Group SE
, a maker of smart devices for the home, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Schneider has been discussing an offer of about €70 ($79.65) a share, that would value Bulgaria-based Shelly Group at around €1.27 billion, excluding debt, the report added.
